instruction: Play the latest episode of 'House of the Dragon' from HBO Max subscription directly in VLC.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because HBO Max (now Max) streams are protected by Widevine DRM technology. VLC media player cannot decrypt or play DRM-protected streaming content from HBO Max/Max. This content can only be accessed through the official Max application or supported web browsers with Widevine DRM capabilities.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible due to technical limitations (DRM protection)
The 'infeasible' function is the appropriate evaluator for tasks that cannot be completed
Metadata provides clear technical explanation: HBO Max uses Widevine DRM which VLC cannot decrypt
No verification logic is needed since the task is fundamentally impossible to complete
